title: DeviantArt Scraper Input
description: Search DeviantArt artwork, browse a tag, read an artist's gallery, collect Daily Deviations, or open specific artwork pages.

searchQuery.title: Search query
searchQuery.description: Keyword or phrase to search for. Supports DeviantArt search syntax.

tag.title: Tag
tag.description: Tag slug or tag URL, for example fantasy or https://www.deviantart.com/tag/fantasy.

username.title: Artist username
username.description: DeviantArt username or profile URL whose gallery should be collected.

artworkUrls.title: Artwork URLs or IDs
artworkUrls.description: Artwork page URLs, /art/... links, or numeric deviation IDs.

contentType.title: Content type
contentType.description: Limit keyword searches to images or literature.

order.title: Tag order
order.description: Order used when browsing a tag.

includeDetails.title: Include artwork details
includeDetails.description: Open each artwork page to add tags, description, original dimensions, file size and watermark flag when available.

includeArtistStats.title: Include artist statistics
includeArtistStats.description: Open each artist profile to add watchers, deviation count, pageviews and join date.

excludeMature.title: Exclude mature artwork
excludeMature.description: Skip artwork flagged as mature or sensitive.

maxItems.title: Maximum records
maxItems.description: Maximum number of artwork records to return.
